ModMetaData.name: Opening World: Two Blocs (Demo)
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
A runnable demonstration of the "opening world" pipeline: a Worldbuilder preset (the stage/scene) + a matching Faction Relation Seeder table (the opening diplomacy), wired together.

Ships a Worldbuilder preset "Two Blocs" that themes vanilla factions into a blue settler bloc and a red tribal bloc, plus a RelationSeedDef that makes each bloc internally allied and the two blocs at war — the opening political geometry the preset alone cannot express.

Content is a NEUTRAL DEMO on vanilla factions (no DLC, no extra faction mods) — replace the roster/relations with your own theme.

Data only (no code). Requires Faction Relation Seeder (the engine). Worldbuilder is optional: without it the RelationSeedDef still fires on new games; the preset simply won't appear in the preset list.
